decider: agent (Claude, in the Claude Code session)
protocol: first round of a new task: no previous round to analyse; the harness runs task_init (checklist from the reference + generic / family priors) before training
human_input: user 2026-10-25: chose the source video (videos/candidates/csf2.mp4) and required the retarget to match the GVHMR result (left arm, palms on the floor); 'start training with the framework we fixed'
reference: dataset/cartwheel_2/g1_lock_vlm_hold_50fps.npz (GVHMR -> GMR with arms matched by position (left-arm offset bug) + elbow branch escape -> palm-down wrists while a hand is planted -> ground fix incl. hand contacts (root height only) -> foot lock -> 2.5 s held final pose); labels_hold_50fps.npz (stand, lunge, support, land, settle, stand; feet + hand contacts)
priorities: P1 learn the whole flow once: lunge -> hands -> legs over -> land -> stand
P2 do not terminate what the reference itself does: it lands and stands in a WIDE stance (ankle distance 0.68 m vs 0.23 m for the backflip) with torso tilt up to ~26 deg in settle
P3 physics needed by the skill: hands must be able to carry load (frictionless hand geoms in the stock model)
transferred_generic_lessons: hold-final-pose-2s (reference with held final pose; eval +5 s)
walk-to-reference / waist-twist-heading (global anchor terms limited after the main event; automatic in flip mode)
quiet-stance / stand-still / reward-gate-boundary (rest-pose terms cover all frames after the event; automatic)
not_transferred: backflip task-level terms (hip tuck, arms in air, legs stand, pre-stand arms) and aerial-family technique rewards: their phases (crouch / takeoff / flight) do not exist in this clip, so they are inactive
code_changes: harness generalised to tasks (rl/flip_auto/taskcfg.py, AUTOMIMIC_TASK; backflip_3 keeps its historical paths)
rl/mimic_generic.set_hand_friction + --hand-friction in train / eval / robustness (hand geoms condim 3, friction 0.6)
eval_flip_robust: rotation success threshold = 0.9 x the reference's own rotation (was fixed 330 deg)
stop_criteria: family:hand_support gates (rotation >= 0.9 x reference, landed upright) + generic hold / post gates

expect.rotation: >= 0.5 x reference after one round from scratch (learning signal, not the stop gate)
expect.no early termination storm: mean episode length grows over the round
